listingTitle: Avoid rebuilding growing sequences in loops
title: Avoid rebuilding growing sequences in loops
why: Rebuilding a growing list, tuple, or bytes value copies the accumulated prefix on each iteration and can turn linear construction into quadratic work.
suggestion: Append mutable elements and convert once, collect chunks and join once, or otherwise build the final sequence without repeatedly copying its prefix.
limitations: Only self-assignment with + for proven list, tuple, or bytes variables, plus += for proven tuple or bytes variables, is reported.
The sequence must be declared outside the active loop; aliasing, reassignment, custom operators, and bounded loop cost are not inferred.
